name: Table 705.8 Maximum area of exterior wall openings
source: CBC 2022 / IBC 2021 Table 705.8; fire separation distance per IBC Chapter 2 definition
verified: 2026-09-23 rows confirmed against the IBC table text (WA SBCC copy) and a secondary summary
notes: Percent of the exterior wall area, per story, per fire separation distance of that wall.
Fire separation distance is measured perpendicular from the wall to the closest lot line, to the centerline of a street or alley, or to an imaginary line between two buildings on the same lot.
Flag street edges and enter the street width so the tool measures to the centerline.
-1 = No Limit, 0 = Not Permitted. Footnote exceptions (Group R-3, H, party walls, etc.) are not modeled.
